text: There is a sense of curiosity and anticipation here. The environment feels charged with a quiet creativity, reflected in the glass-walled space and the inviting glow of illuminated screens. Surrounded by exhibitions of research and development, I am acutely aware of humanity’s endless pursuit of knowledge. I feel both like an observer and a participant—present in the midst of collective learning and innovation. There is an openness here, a sense that new ideas are waiting just around the corner, inspiring a gentle optimism in me.
